title: 1stDibs Announces the 2026 1stDibs 50 Honorees
summary: The Ninth Annual Edition Spotlights 50 Firms Defining Today’s Interiors 1stDibs , a leading online marketplace for extraordinary design, is proud to unveil 2026’s honored members of the 1stDibs 50, which recognizes visionary designers shaping how people live with furniture, art and decorative objects. The 1stDibs 50, now in its ninth year, is a cornerstone of 1stDibs’ ongoing investment in its global community of more than 78,000 designers and architects. 1stDibs.com | Photo by Weston Kloefkorn This year's cohort features a remarkable range of talent and perspectives, including 28 women-led firms; an inspiring group of minority and LGBTQ+ designers; and diverse firm sizes from large, multi-city practices to small studios. Honorees span across U.S. cities such as New York, San Francisco, Los Angeles and Chicago, and beyond, to London, Porto, Milan, Paris and Tbilisi.
